units.source_text: 源氏内大臣极想看看这复信，但觉未便启口。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, very much wanted to see this reply, but felt it would be improper to ask.

units.source_text: 他想：“朱雀院容貌姣好，宛若处女；

en.t: He thought, "Suzaku-in is handsome and graceful, almost like a maiden;

units.source_text: 前斋宫也妩媚多姿，与他不相上下。

en.t: the former Kamo Priestess is also charming and full of grace, in no way inferior to him.
They truly make a match made in heaven.
Emperor Reizei is far too young.

units.source_text: 我这样乱点鸳鸯谱，生怕她心中怨恨呢。”

en.t: By arranging such an unsuitable match on my own, I fear she may resent me in her heart."

units.source_text: 他体察到细微之处，不觉胸中异常懊丧。

en.t: As he considered all these subtle points, his heart became unbearably dejected.

units.source_text: 但时至今日，事已无可挽回，只得教人筹备入宫之事，务使齐全周到。

en.t: But by now the matter could no longer be undone, so he had people prepare for her entry into the palace, making sure everything was complete and carefully arranged.

units.source_text: 他吩咐素来信任的那个修理大夫兼宰相，叫他照料一切，不得有误。

en.t: He instructed the Director of Repairs and Councillor, whom he had always trusted, to oversee everything and allow no mistakes.
He himself then went ahead into the palace first.

units.source_text: 深恐朱雀院见怪，他自然不露出代替前斋宫父母照拂一切的样子，只表示请安的态度。

en.t: Deeply afraid that Suzaku-in might find it strange, he naturally did not show himself as someone managing everything in place of the former Kamo Priestess's parents, and merely adopted the manner of paying his respects.
